name: @escapement/engine
description: Runs the audio engine in the browser: the WebAssembly build thread, the AudioWorklet and the shared memory between them.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo wasm && mkdir -p wasm && wasm-opt --stack-check -O3 ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/engine_wasm.wasm -o wasm/engine.wasm
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p src/worklet && tsc -p src/build-thread && tsc -p src/clock-thread && tsc -p test
